caseName: Smith v. City of St. Martinville
caseNameFull: Nary SMITH v. CITY OF ST. MARTINVILLE, LOUISIANA.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied. Petitioner allowed until May 11, 2015, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
